prompts.sprout: Create ACTUAL PRODUCTION REPLACEMENT CEL SPRITESHEET for this 2D game animation. Fixed front three-quarter camera, stable shading, identical brushwork/palette/outline in every cel. IMPORTANT: do not crop sprites. Use at most 76% of EACH CELL width and 76% height. Keep at least 12% transparent gutter around EACH sprite; the sprites must never touch cell edges or each other. Every cel's ground anchor at x50%, y85% of cell. Same scale and body proportions in every cel except deliberate modest growth between levels. Reference 1 is the approved level-2 design; reference 2 is approved level-3, final cel must match reference 2 exactly. Draw coherent entire objects, no cutout rig artifacts, tears, fragments, missing surfaces, floating pieces, rectangular slices, doubled edges or ghosting. Subject: ivory sprout flower nest, green base leaves, peach seed center and two green shoots. CEL 1 open level2, cels2-4 its two large ivory petals fold inward smoothly into ONE closed pointed bud, hiding the center. Cels5-8 the closed bud grows slightly while the level3 wooden support arms, wood vine-wrapped winch and gold/wood rim assemble and remain properly attached around its base. Cels9-16 the bud petals open progressively into the approved level3 flower, and support arms unfold around REAL hinges while remaining attached. The curled petal tips must be continuously curved and intact, never sliced flat. Base leaves stay planted; do not shake or vary the camera. Keep the flowers, arms, vines and leaves correctly overlapping in every drawing. No extra props.
